text:
priya_support: heads-up — customer J-273 reports steady 500ms+ p99 and duplicate billing traces when their app hits our API during failover window. ticket #INC-9876.
customer-jess: seeing requests bounce between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for the same logical call, sometimes both succeed, both billed. sdk v1.8.2.
sam_engineer: ugh. can you paste a minimal repro or logs? are they using hedged/parallel attempts?
customer-jess: they said they turned on hedgedRetries and set perAttemptTimeout=700ms with maxAttempts=3. here's an excerpt of their client config:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  hedgedRetries: true,
  perAttemptTimeoutMs: 700,
  maxAttempts: 3,
  regionPreference: ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"],
});
```
priya_support: attached logs show two successful 200s back-to-back from different regions for same request id. sample header dump: `x-request-id: j-273-5f`, `x-region: us-east-1` then `x-region: eu-west-1` ~120ms later.
marcus_infra: that pattern suggests SDK is issuing hedged attempts without dedup on the server side. our router accepts both and executes. we should avoid double execution for idempotent endpoints — but generative endpoints aren't idempotent.
sam_engineer: is the SDK sending a per-request trace header so the runtime can dedupe? we have X-Client-Trace but SDK needs to forward a stable request UUID.
customer-jess: SDK includes X-Client-Req but it changes per attempt currently. they said they expect router to stick once first attempt is in flight.
priya_support: repro steps I requested: 1) enable hedgedRetries + guest payload (non-idempotent) 2) set low perAttemptTimeout (<=800ms) 3) route pref list with cross-region fallback 4) run 1000 reqs with synthetic latency on primary region -> we see ~0.7% double-exec.
sam_engineer: hypothesis: SDK backoff/jitter logic picks alternative region immediately on attempt timeout without canceling inflight attempt; and router treats each connection as independent execution. two paths: change SDK to 1) keep stable request-id across attempts so servers can dedupe, or 2) cancel slower attempt when alternative wins (client-side cancel), or 3) change router to prefer first-active and ignore later duplicate attempts within a short window.
marcus_infra: quick mitigation: honor `x-client-req` for dedupe at ingress LB for a 2s window. longer-term: add server-side hedged dedupe and prefer sticky routing for failover windows.
priya_support: customer wants instructions to avoid duplicates now. recommended short-term client fix?
sam_engineer: advise disabling hedgedRetries or increase perAttemptTimeout to >=1500ms and set maxAttempts=1 for non-idempotent endpoints. also set `preserveRequestIdAcrossAttempts: true` in next SDK minor.
customer-jess: can you provide the config snippet we should apply immediately?
sam_engineer: ```js
// temporary config to avoid double-exec
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  hedgedRetries: false,
  perAttemptTimeoutMs: 2000, // wait longer for primary
  maxAttempts: 1,
});
// OR preserve ID (if they upgrade):
const client2 = new RedwoodClient({
  hedgedRetries: true,
  preserveRequestIdAcrossAttempts: true,
  maxAttempts: 2,
});
```
priya_support: sent these mitigation steps to the customer and asked for post-change logs. also escalated to infra for ingress dedupe patch.
marcus_infra: opened INF-452 to add short-window dedupe by `x-client-req` at the edge + populate `x-region-origin` for billing clarity.
sam_engineer: we'll also schedule an SDK patch to set stable request ids by default when hedgedRetries=true. tagging release team.
devops-bot: deploy queued — infra branch inf/ingress-dedupe -> staging (ci/24) :package: 
customer-jess: thanks, applying temporary disable now. will report back in ~30m. :pray: 
priya_support: thanks everyone. I'll update ticket INC-9876 with repro, logs, and mitigation steps.
